title: ALBERT shared Transformer block with depth Mirror coordinates
hypothesis: On a learnable synthetic sequence task, one shared Transformer block plus one small depth-specific Givens coordinate will recover per-depth predictive function lost by ALBERT-style hard sharing, beyond a byte-matched scalar residual gate, while using materially fewer bytes than untied layers.
physical_object: one Transformer block recurrently applied four times to a causal sequence
mirror_coordinate: four learned Givens angles applied across adjacent residual channels after each shared block application
logical_multiplicity: four logical depth roles from one physical shared block

model.data: Synthetic second-order modular recurrence sequences; each world fixes recurrence coefficients from its seed, and the model predicts the next token autoregressively. Fresh worlds use distinct coefficients and sequences.

controls: ALBERT full sharing: attention, FFN, and normalization shared across all four layer applications
attention-only sharing with layer-specific FFN and normalization
FFN-only sharing with layer-specific attention and normalization
fully shared block plus four direct scalar residual-branch gates (matched 4-code control)
fully shared block plus four depth-specific Givens angles
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: untied validation accuracy >=0.70; hard-tied block has measurable final NLL gap >=0.02 nat versus untied; Mirror lowers final NLL >=5% versus hard tying and >=5% versus scalar gates; Mirror within 0.05 nat of untied; Mirror payload <=1.10x scalar-gate payload and <=0.60x untied payload; depth-prefix NLL improves over tied at >=2 of 4 depths; rotation MAC overhead <=10% total block MACs. Otherwise keep fresh sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds reproduce quality gains and depth-prefix improvements; actual payload <=0.60x untied; Mirror beats same-byte scalar control by >=5% NLL; active MAC <=1.10x tied; serialized metric/hash replay exact.
failure_gate: Mirror fails the registered NLL improvement versus hard tying or scalar in both development seeds; depth-prefix benefit absent; or storage/compute limits fail.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: all attention, FFN, norm and embedding weights
all four depth gates or Givens codes
architecture IDs, metadata, and archive headers

compute.mac_convention: linear projections counted as one MAC per weight; attention score and value products counted by their multiply-accumulate operations; pointwise operations reported separately

boundaries: small synthetic sequence task only; no BERT, language-model or natural-text claim
fresh seeds change the recurrence world and are not used for tuning
logical depth roles are not independent capacity; assess measured per-prefix predictive quality
fixed-update result is learning-efficiency evidence, not a near-converged capacity claim
fresh IDs remain sealed until every development gate passes
